reason: Karina's Law was signed; re-cited from another member's ILGA page to her own (profile review, 2026-10-07)

overview.text: She sponsored a bill requiring secondary schools to use female manikins in CPR training. She sponsored a 2022 law concerning gun safety information in schools. She sponsored legislation to regulate algorithmic pricing. Hirschauer also sponsored a bill requiring gun owners to securely store firearms near children. She was the chief sponsor of Karina's Law, signed in February 2025, which requires police to remove guns from people under domestic-violence orders of protection.
